note: THE SOURCE MANIFEST. Every repository this site documents, the branch it is documented FROM, and
what may be read out of it. The generator reads nothing that is not declared here.
BRANCH SELECTION IS EXPLICIT AND PER-REPO, AND THAT IS NOT PEDANTRY. Measured 2026-08-01: the live
work in this estate is NOT on default branches. UNI-FLAGELLUM's main has 9 commits while the real
work on hierarchical-aif/motor-stack has 122. A pipeline that defaulted to 'main' would publish a
skeleton and call it the system. Every branch below was measured, not assumed.

citation_policy.rule: Every citation records repo + branch + commit sha + path (+ line range where applicable).
consequence: NO SOURCE REPO IS PUBLIC YET, so a citation cannot be a clickable permalink today. The site
therefore renders citations as UNRESOLVABLE and says so on the page, in the citation itself.
That is deliberate. A citation a reader cannot open is an appeal to authority; the honest
response is to mark it, not to hide it or to imply it can be checked. When a source repo is
